about: Killing Chainsaw Man Is the Reason This Heart Still Beats is a black-and-white manga panel from Chainsaw Man. Katana Man, a devil hybrid with a blade jutting from his head and arms, stands in a dark coat and raises his sword in the foreground, with two speech balloons beside him. In the original he swears that killing Chainsaw Man is what keeps him alive; in the template the part naming his goal is blank, leaving only "...is the reason!!" and "This heart still beats!!" So the panel becomes a dramatic oath of devotion to anything, however small or petty.
origin: The panel comes from Tatsuki Fujimoto's manga Chainsaw Man. Katana Man is out for revenge on Denji, the Chainsaw Man, which is why he declares that killing him is his reason to live. The blanked version spread as an editable template among manga fans.
usage:
There is only one box, placed in the empty space at the top right, directly above "IS THE REASON!!" Write the thing that keeps you going as a short noun phrase, so the panel reads as a full sentence: "[your text] is the reason!! This heart still beats!!"

The contrast between a life-or-death vow and a trivial motive is the joke. Petty grudges, snacks, upcoming releases, a weekend lie-in or proving someone wrong all work. Keep it under about eight words so it fits the space and reads as a battle cry.
